_meta.status: PILOT v6 - D-032 place page. Not registered in CLAIMS.md, not on the site.
_meta.method: Every stratum of every cleaned Nigeria recruitment is evidence about a place (a Meta targeting geometry). Places pool across recruitments: spend summed, people summed, never ratios averaged. People are assigned to a place by the ad-set metadata written at their first message (inference_data variables with location 'metadata'; where sibling studies shared stratum labels, by the Fly 'creative' recorded on their first response and the ad set that was spending that day).
cleaning_rules: USD ad account (account 2976439342687286 is naira: excluded)
spend from Insights per ad set (campaigns shared inside a family counted once, attributed by the study's final campaign name)
people recruited by ads: first message inside the ad set's spend window (1 day before to 3 after) and carrying ad metadata
sibling studies de-duplicated: each person once per recruitment
pins and regions checked against GeoNames/Natural Earth; the Kirfi 'place' (67 km off) is out
qualifying rule = the recruitment's final question_targeting, recounted from inference_data
_meta.thresholds: places shown with at least 50 people who started; under 200 flagged

definitions.started: a person whose first message in the survey carried the ad metadata of an ad set targeting this place, during that ad set's run
definitions.qualified: a person who started and then answered the recruitment's final quota-rule question (its question_targeting 'answered' variable)
definitions.cost_per_qualified: Insights spend / qualified people, pooled only within one questionnaire

terms.whole_state: ads shown to people Meta places anywhere inside the state's official boundary
terms.radius_area: a pin or Meta city plus a radius; 'inside the radius areas' and 'outside them' are the two sides
terms.recruitment: one round of ads filling one set of quotas; sibling studies that fed one survey are one recruitment

all_people_surveyed.note: Anyone who answered in any Nigeria study on the current platform (distinct inference_data user_id over studies with country NG). Unchanged from v4.

totals.note: people who started in two recruitments are counted in each
